div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 430px;

span.p:
Inputs
your file (Excel, CSV or PDF) · your scorecard · optional source documents

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 430px;

span.p:
1 · Freeze
read once · lock the file and the scorecard with a fingerprint (hash)
make sure three different AI families are set up
check every sheet the scorecard names exists

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Count in code
exact counts give a pass share per question
the share turns into a 0-5 mark

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Examiners 1, 2, 3 mark on their own, at the same time
same instructions · 0-5 per question · each mark points at a cell

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does the mark point at a real cell?
sheet and cell exist
quote really in the cell

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Set the claim aside
(recorded in the report)

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Final reviewer compares the three sets of marks
merges repeated issues

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Code applies the rules
the mark stays inside the Examiners' range
a gap over 1 point needs evidence from the file
otherwise the lower mark stands

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 · Decide by a fixed rule
weighted score out of 100
below 60 red · 60-74 amber · 75+ green

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · Report
what to fix first · path to green · charts
PDF, Excel and Markdown · full record kept

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check the file again
stop if it changed mid-run
